topics.label: BiodivFuture · Spain AEI / FB conditions
topics.description: V6 national rules, 4 November 2026: AEI covers all environments but Spanish AEI-funded groups may participate only in proposals addressing A/B; Theme C is excluded even when combined with A/B. FB covers marine/coastal environments on A/B/C, so an inland dryland proposal cannot assume FB funding. Beneficiaries are nonprofit research organisations in Spain with previous AEI competitive funding, subject to national PCI/PI rules. One AEI/FB applicant per proposal; two only if one coordinates. National application is due within one week after preproposal submission. Late addition at stage two is normally not allowed, with a narrow low-participation exception requiring funder confirmation. The AEI-labelled budget-cap graphic has now been visually checked and is detailed in the attached funding finding; underlying PCI/PI documents still need review.

topics.label: Water4All · Spain AEI research route
topics.description: Spanish nonprofit research organisations, with prior AEI competitive funding at least once since 2015, subject to PCI and PI requirements. Main topic must be 2, 3 or 4 and Spanish activities only those topics. Other partners may address Topic 1 to a minor extent, no more than 30% of total content; the Spanish AEI group must not support those Topic 1 activities. One AEI applicant per proposal, or two if one coordinates. National AEI application within one week of preproposal submission; failing it breaches eligibility. The AEI budget-cap graphic has now been visually checked and is detailed in the attached funding finding; linked PCI/PI rules still require review.

findings.label: Call-specific Spanish AEI caps · visually checked
findings.text: The two inspected tables independently show the same AEI-labelled project configurations: one AEI applicant maximum direct costs €140,000 plus €35,000 indirect = €175,000 total; one AEI coordinator €220,000 + €55,000 = €275,000; an AEI coordinator and one other AEI applicant combined €260,000 + €65,000 = €325,000. A justified substantial-experimental-task supplement per project is at most €30,000 direct + €7,500 indirect = €37,500. Existing-data reanalysis alone does not qualify for that supplement. Indirect costs are 25% of direct including subcontracting; direct costs must be rounded to thousands. These are ceilings for the table’s configurations, not an applicant grant-rate promise or a universal AEI rule. The BiodivFuture shared Spain annex uses AEI row labels; do not silently turn them into an independent FB entitlement. These caps are unrelated to Water4All CDTI’s €150,000 minimum financeable budget or the unverified general PID minimum.
